# NeoHub Coworking Space

> Premium coworking centres in Gomti Nagar, Lucknow — private cabins, dedicated workstations, hot desks, and conference rooms for startups and growing teams.

NeoHub operates three hubs in Vibhuti Khand / Gomti Nagar and serves professionals across Lucknow, including Hazratganj, Aliganj, and Indira Nagar.

## Primary contact

- Website: [neohubspaces.in](https://www.neohubspaces.in)
- Email: [contact@neohubspaces.in](mailto:contact@neohubspaces.in)
- Phone / WhatsApp: [+91 70004 81286](tel:+917000481286)

## Locations

- [Bhavya Corporate Tower (primary)](https://www.neohubspaces.in/gomti-nagar): 4th Floor, Vijaipur Colony, Vibhuti Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow 226010 — +91 70004 81286 (open 24 hours)
- [Cyber Heights](https://www.neohubspaces.in/gomti-nagar): 2nd Floor, Levana Cyber Heights, TC-212, opposite Indira Gandhi Pratishthan, Vibhuti Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow 226010 — +91 70004 81286
- [Experion](https://www.neohubspaces.in/gomti-nagar): 6th Floor, 611, Vibhuti Khand, Gomti Nagar 226010 — +91 70004 81286 (9 am–10 pm)

## Pricing (indicative, + GST)

See the live table: [NeoHub pricing](https://www.neohubspaces.in/pricing)

- Workstation: from ₹5,500/month (Cyber Heights / Bhavya); ₹6,500/month (Experion)
- Private cabin: from ₹20,000/cabin/month (Cyber Heights / Bhavya); ₹25,000/cabin/month (Experion)
- Conference booking: ₹500/hour (Cyber Heights / Bhavya); ₹600/hour (Experion)
- Virtual office: ₹12,000/year address, or ₹18,000/year GST kit (Gomti Nagar address; not a Google Business Profile)
- Hours: Bhavya 24 hours; Cyber Heights reception 9 AM–5 PM; Experion 9 AM–10 PM

Confirm current availability and rates when booking a tour via [Contact](https://www.neohubspaces.in/contact) or WhatsApp [+91 70004 81286](https://wa.me/917000481286).
